parsed.note_claim: Lard is rendered pork fat, while tallow is rendered beef fat.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Beef fat used for cooking is typically called tallow . Tallow is made by rendering beef fat... Pork fat used in cooking is called lard. Lard is made by rendering the fat from pork
parsed.reason: The page explicitly defines tallow as rendered beef fat and lard as rendered pork fat, directly substantiating the note's distinction between the two products.
